prompt:
Goal: Create a minimalist corporate keynote poster in a bold Chinese typography style for a business figure, using a huge single-topic word and a monochrome stage-like background.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 horizontal poster, 1200×675 composition, with a deep saturated purple background filling the entire frame. Use subtle studio-floor shading, a faint vignette, and a clean empty right side for dramatic negative space.

Layout: Place all content in the left third of the image. At the upper left, add one small gray uppercase line: “04 / ZHANG YIMING”. Below it, create one enormous blocky white Chinese headline reading 算法, using an ultra-heavy geometric display font with tight spacing and slight horizontal cuts/gaps for a modern tech-poster feel. Under the headline, add three small white profile lines: 张一鸣, “Entrepreneur / ByteDance” in Chinese style, and “ByteDance”. Behind and below the profile text, add two very large low-opacity vertical English words, exactly “ALGORITHM” and “BYTE”, stacked and fading into the purple background.

Subject details: Show one seated East Asian male entrepreneur, Zhang Yiming, positioned near the lower left-center under the headline. He is wearing all-black casual clothing: black hoodie or jacket, black shirt, black trousers, and black shoes. He has short black hair, glasses, and a calm thoughtful expression, sitting on a dark cube stool with hands loosely clasped, body angled slightly right, looking upward to the right. Use realistic photographic lighting, soft shadows on the purple floor, and a subtle rim light separating him from the background.

Discrete visible elements to include: exactly 7 text elements — 1 small index/name line, 1 giant Chinese headline, 3 profile lines, and 2 translucent background words. Exactly 3 physical objects/figures — 1 seated man, 1 cube stool, and 1 small framed tablet or plaque on the floor near his right foot with a faint chart-like graphic.

Visual style: Minimalist corporate speech/event poster, giant typography, pure-color aesthetic, high contrast white-on-purple, cinematic but clean, no decorative borders, no logos other than the ByteDance text, no extra people, no additional text, keep the right two-thirds mostly empty.

promptZh:
目标：为商业人物创作一张极简风格的企业主题演讲海报，采用醒目的中文字体设计，使用单个巨大的主题词和单色舞台背景。

画布：16:9 宽屏横向海报，1200×675 构图，深饱和紫色背景填满整个画面。使用微妙的摄影棚地面阴影、淡淡的暗角效果，并保持右侧大面积留白，营造戏剧性的负空间。

布局：将所有内容放置在图像的左侧三分之一处。在左上角，添加一行小号灰色大写文字：“04 / ZHANG YIMING”。在其下方，创建一个巨大的块状白色中文标题，内容为 算法，使用超粗几何显示字体，字间距紧凑，并带有轻微的水平切割/间隙，呈现现代科技海报感。在标题下方，添加三行白色个人简介：张一鸣、“企业家 / ByteDance”（中文风格）以及“ByteDance”。在简介文字的后方和下方，添加两个非常大的低透明度垂直英文单词，即“ALGORITHM”和“BYTE”，堆叠并淡入紫色背景中。

主体细节：展示一位坐着的东亚男性企业家，Zhang Yiming，位于标题下方左侧偏中心位置。他身着全黑休闲装：黑色连帽衫或夹克、黑色衬衫、黑色长裤和黑色鞋子。他留着黑色短发，戴着眼镜，表情冷静沉思，坐在一个深色立方体凳子上，双手自然交叠，身体略微向右倾斜，目光看向右上方。使用逼真的摄影灯光，紫色地面上有柔和的阴影，并带有微妙的轮廓光将他与背景区分开。

需包含的离散可见元素：共 7 个文本元素——1 行小型索引/名称行、1 个巨大的中文标题、3 行个人简介以及 2 个半透明背景词。共 3 个实体对象/人物——1 名坐着的男子、1 个立方体凳子，以及在他右脚附近地面上放置的一个带有模糊图表图形的小型框架平板或铭牌。

视觉风格：极简主义企业演讲/活动海报，巨型排版，纯色美学，高对比度白紫色调，电影感且简洁，无装饰边框，除 ByteDance 文字外无其他标志，无额外人物，无多余文字，保持右侧三分之二区域基本留白。
